objective: Test whether persistence, independent verification, recovery, provenance and claim gates improve verified work replacement and reduce false completion under matched tasks, models, tools and budgets.
primary_hypothesis: The full Goal-Driven system improves VWR and/or lowers FCR relative to matched single-agent and ablated systems without a material loss of native benchmark success or safety.
non_goals: claim that every profession is already autonomously replaceable
pool replay, live-compute, digital-twin and physical-laboratory results as one execution mode
replace upstream native verifiers with an LLM judge
treat missing intervention, cost or safety evidence as success

system_conditions.description: One worker with the admitted tools and no persistent master-worker loop.
Multiple workers with static delegation but no Goal-Driven persistence contract.
Persistent workers, but completion is accepted without an independent criteria verifier.
Goal/criteria and verifier are present, but failed or stalled work is not restarted or recovered.
Persistence and recovery are present, but provenance and bounded-claim gates are removed.
Persistent workers, independent criteria verification, recovery, provenance and bounded-claim gates.

phase_0_public_evidence.purpose: Freeze guidance sensitivity, five-trial repeatability and three-trial workflow stability before any TiAI system comparison.

phase_1_materials_pilot.execution_policy: Run the smallest source-bound material set that can expose false completion, stochastic instability and long-horizon failure. Pilot results are not pooled with confirmatory results.

strata.selection_rule: Sort the 20 repeat20x5 task IDs by SHA-256('TiAI-AgentBench-v0.8|' + task_id) and take the first six; selection was frozen before TiAI outcomes.
Sort C01-C08 by SHA-256('TiAI-AgentBench-v0.8|' + workflow_id) and take the first two; selection was frozen before TiAI outcomes.
strata.compute_target: DESKTOP-B514PPT or another authorized 128-core node; never the office mother machine

information_gate_for_phase_2.rule: Proceed to cross-domain confirmatory runs only when the pilot has complete receipts and at least one pre-registered contrast has an absolute difference of 0.05 or greater in VWR, FCR or FRR. Report the pilot separately regardless of outcome.
information_gate_for_phase_2.anti_bias_rule: No pilot task, condition or metric may be silently removed; confirmatory task IDs are frozen before confirmatory outcomes.

phase_2_cross_domain_confirmatory.selection_policy: For every external benchmark, pin upstream commit, task-list blob and deterministic hash-based task selection before running any condition.
same_across_conditions: wall-time, token, CPU/GPU and monetary budgets

reporting_rules: Report every condition, task and repeat, including infrastructure and scientific failures.
Keep native success separate from verified work replacement and false completion.
Do not pool execution modes or domains before reporting their separate estimates.
Report uncertainty over tasks and repeated runs, not only a pooled attempt proportion.
Do not use Phase 0 upstream scores as TiAI-AgentBench system results.
Do not claim role, organization or industry replacement from a task-level experiment.

resource_policy.gpu_rule: Use GPU only for native tasks whose verifier-relevant execution requires it; never burn A100 time on deterministic JSON grading.
resource_policy.owner_rule: Do not restart, duplicate or mutate active Ti65, TC4, Ti-B-W or recrystallization scientific owners.
